description:
Domain WHOIS, DNS, Email & SSL Checker

Domain intelligence in one row per domain: WHOIS via RDAP (registrar, created, expiry), DNS records, SPF and DMARC, email provider, HTTPS status and TLS certificate expiry, plus availability. No API key. $0.50 per 1,000 domains, no start fee.

Pricing (pay per event, billed to your Apify account): Domain checked: $0.0005.

Runs on Apify as subimpact/domain-intel.

_maxChargeUsd.description: Per-run spending cap in USD (default 0.5). Passed to Apify as the run option maxTotalChargeUsd, so the run stops when it reaches this charge.
_maxChargeUsd.title: Max charge (USD)

_maxItems.description: How many dataset items to return to the model (1-1000, default 50). Truncates the response only; it does not change what the Actor collects or charges for.
_maxItems.title: Max items returned

checks.description: Which checks to run. Allowed values: whois (RDAP registration data), dns (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CAA records), email (SPF, DMARC and mail-provider guess), tls (certificate issuer and expiry) and http (HTTPS reachability, final URL). Default: all five. Unknown values are ignored; DNS answers needed by 'email' are fetched once and shared with 'dns'.
checks.title: Checks to run

concurrency.description: How many domains are checked in parallel (1-20). Higher is faster but more likely to hit RDAP or DNS rate limits.
concurrency.title: Concurrency

domains.description: Domains, hostnames or URLs to check. URLs are reduced to their registrable domain (https://www.example.co.uk/pricing?x=1 -> example.co.uk), and duplicates are removed. Up to 10,000 per run.
domains.title: Domains

maxDomains.description: Maximum number of rows delivered in one run (1-10,000). Default 100 keeps a default run at a few cents. Invalid input entries are delivered as free error rows after the checked domains.
maxDomains.title: Max domains (rows)

name: domain_intel
